projects.title: Knots Cypher
projects.role: Creative Direction / Video Editing / Music Production / Event Coordination
projects.summary:
A cypher performance in my store by 3 underground australian artists (Jonny Chops, Villyszn & zPluto) performing an original song produced by me.
Artists are all wearing my brand Knots. The editing of the video, lighting, event setup and promotion was all done by me.

projects.title: Knots Halloween Event
projects.category: Event Management / Graphic Design / Video Editing / Fashion
projects.role: Graphic Design / Marketer / Video Editor / Event Management
projects.summary:
In collaboration with bucckk22 and places.save, two community driven brands.
I hosted a halloween event at my retail store.
I was in charge of the graphic design, video editing & overall promotion and management of the event.
Over 200 people attended.

projects.title: Knots AW23 Runway Show
projects.role: Event Manager / Promotion & Marketing / Fashion Design & Production / Creative Direction / Music Curation
projects.summary:
In 2023 I through my first runway show to launch my clothing brand Knots (formerly Alchemy), as it was my event I was in charge of all elements with the help of my business partner. We got over 200 people to attend the event and had Sydney hip-hop artist Ayce perform some of his songs to warm the crowd. We also hired a painter to make a large mural, which the runway models later walked through for the runway show.
Overall a largely successful event

projects.title: Void Pavilion
projects.summary: A one-night immersive event staged inside a raw concrete shell, lit with a single directional source.
projects.narrative: Void Pavilion turned an empty industrial shell into a one-night experience. A single lighting axis carved the space into exposure and concealment, guiding four hundred guests through sound, projection, and movement without a single sign.

projects.title: Thread Study
projects.summary: A macro investigation of copper metallic thread woven through heavy cacao wool — texture as the subject.
projects.narrative: Thread Study zooms in until the garment disappears and only the material remains. Shot at macro distance under Rembrandt light, the series treats thread, weave, and sheen as the true craft of fashion production.
